interpretation_guardrails: All ten original pop-culture units are persons, so the field denominator remains 10 without a mixed-unit split.
The printed name 비 is preserved while the canonical person is 정지훈 with the Rain identity anchor.
이미경 is the CJ entertainment executive identity_key 이미경|cj_enm_business and must never be merged with the politician 이미경.
김종학 is anchored to the television PD/김종학프로덕션 identity.
This field has an unusually high T0 baseline: all ten had already reached scope3 before selection. Raw Major therefore mostly measures persistence, not future-rise prediction.
박찬욱 score4 is based on cumulative post-selection global-cinema apex recognition plus 2026 Cannes Competition Jury presidency, not merely on the pre-T0 2004 Grand Prix.
International fame alone does not create score4; Rain, 박지성, 최경주 and 홍명보 remain score3 under the frozen anti-inflation rule.
김종학's death truncates later exposure but does not erase his achieved post-selection peak.
